entries.source: Monumenta Boica 24, Monasterium Ensdorf, Castel, Nr. CCXII
entries.german: Ich wilhelm Raydenbucher Ritter an der zeit Lantrichter zu Lenguelt bekenn vnd tun kunt offenlichen mit dem brief daz für mich kom auf der lantschrann zu kalmünz her Cunrad Schechs zu kastel vnd bracht für mit vollem gewalt des Erwirdigen herren des Appts zu kastel vnd des Couents doselbst ainen ganzen guten gerechten brief mit der Lantschrann zu Lenguelt aufgedruckten insigel vnd pat im den mit fürsprechen zu Lesen der lawt von wort zu wort also Ich Cunrad von Rosenberg Vitztum zu Amberg bekenne offenbar mit disem brief das der Nörtweiner der herren einer dez Conuents zu kastel an meines herren des Abbts stat desselben Closters vor mir auf der Lantschrann zu Lenguelt Hannsen vnd Peter den Ernuelfner von helfenberg anbehabt hat mit volg mit frag mit vrteil vnd mit dem rechten als recht ist die Mittermül vnd die Görenmül bey wesenacker an der Laber gelegen für Ledigs rechts freys aigen, das mein herre der Abbt vnd der Couent des Closters zu kastel vnd ir nachkomen, derselben Mittermülen vnd der Görmülen mit allen iren zugehörung sullen sitzen in nütz vnd in gewer als irr ledigen rechten freyen aigen gut Vnd dauon antwürten wer darauf icht zu sprechen hat als recht ist darzu sol ich sie oder wer meins herren Oberigster Amptman ist fürbas von der Lantschrann wegen schützen vnd schirmen als recht ist dez ward von gerichts wegen ain brief erteilt mit des Lantgerichts insigel Geben zu Lenguelt des nechmontags vor Dyonisy do man zalt von Cristus gepurt drewtzehenhundert Jar darnach in dem vier vnd sechzigsten Jare Vnd do der brief vor offner Lantschrann gelesen vnd verhört was worden do pat der obgenant her Chunrad sechechs ainer vrteil zu fragen man solt dem obgenanten Gotzhaws zu kastel den brief pilleichen vernewen mit der Lantschrann anhangendem insigel das ward im erteilt Also gib ich obgenanter wilhelm Raydenbucher im den brief vernewt vnd besigelt mit der Lantschrann zu Lenguelt anhangendem insigel Nach Crists gepurt Viertzehenhundert Jar vnd in dem vierden Jar am montag nach sant Merteins tag. (Cum Sigillo.)
entries.latin: Num. CCXII. Renovatio Testimonii judicialis. ao. 1404.
entries.english: I, Wilhelm Raydenbucher, Ritter, at the time Landrichter at Lengenfeld, acknowledge and make publicly known with this charter that Herr Konrad Schechs of Kastel appeared before me at the Landschranne at Kallmünz and, with full authority of the venerable lord abbot of Kastel and of the convent there, presented a complete, good and lawful charter with the seal of the Landschranne at Lengenfeld impressed upon it, and asked that it be read aloud to him by spokesmen. It runs word for word as follows: I, Konrad von Rosenberg, Vitztum zu Amberg, acknowledge openly with this charter that the Nörtweiner, one of the lords of the convent of Kastel, acting in place of my lord the abbot of that monastery, obtained before me at the Landschranne at Lengenfeld, against Hans and Peter the Ernuelfner of Helfenberg, by pursuit, by inquiry, by judgment and by due process of law, the Mittermühle and the Görenmühle, situated near Wesenacker on the Laber, as unencumbered, lawful, free property; so that my lord the abbot and the convent of the monastery of Kastel and their successors shall hold the same Mittermühle and Görenmühle with all their appurtenances in use and possession as their unencumbered, lawful, free property, and shall answer on it to anyone who has a claim on it, as is lawful. For this I, or whoever is my lord's chief officer hereafter, shall protect and defend them on behalf of the Landschranne, as is lawful. A charter was issued on this by the court with the seal of the Landgericht. Given at Lengenfeld on the Monday before St. Dionysius, in the year of Christ's birth thirteen hundred and sixty-four. And when the charter had been read and heard before the open Landschranne, the aforesaid Herr Konrad Schechs asked for a judgment: whether the charter should rightfully be renewed for the aforesaid house of God at Kastel with the seal hanging from the Landschranne. This was adjudged to him. Therefore I, the aforesaid Wilhelm Raydenbucher, give him the charter renewed and sealed with the seal of the Landschranne at Lengenfeld hanging from it. After Christ's birth fourteen hundred and in the fourth year, on the Monday after St. Martin's day. (With seal.)

facts.content: renewed and sealed with the seal of the Landschranne at Lengenfeld the charter of 1364 for the abbot and convent of Kastel.
presented the charter of 1364 before the Landschranne at Kallmünz on behalf of the abbot and convent of Kastel and asked for its renewal.

declared in 1364 that before him at the Landschranne at Lengenfeld the Nörtweiner of the convent of Kastel obtained, against Hannsen and Peter den Ernuelfner von Helfenberg, the Mittermühle and Görenmühle near Wesenacker on the Laber as free property of the abbot and convent of Kastel.
undertook in 1364 to protect and defend the abbot and convent of Kastel in the Mittermühle and Görenmühle on behalf of the Landschranne.

entries.source: Regesta Boica 11 (Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 11 = Continuatio 7), 17 Nov. 1404
entries.german: Wilhelm Raydenbucher Ritter derzeit Landrichter zu Lengvelt erneut dem Kloster Kastel einen Gerichtsbrief des Cunrad von Rosenberg Vitztum zu Amberg, inhaltlich dessen genanntes Kloster im Jahre 1364 in Nutz und Gewer der Mittermül und der Görenmül bey Wesenacher an der Laber gesetzt worden ist. G. am Montag nach Marteins Tag. (c. Sig)
entries.english: Wilhelm Raydenbucher, Ritter, at present Landrichter at Lengvelt, renews for the monastery of Kastel a court charter of Cunrad von Rosenberg, Vitztum zu Amberg, according to which the said monastery was put in use and possession of the Mittermühle and the Görenmühle near Wesenacher on the Laber in the year 1364. Given on the Monday after St. Martin's day. (With seal.)

facts.content: renewed for the monastery of Kastel the court charter of Konrad von Rosenberg, Vitztum zu Amberg, by which the monastery was put in use and possession of the Mittermühle and Görenmühle near Wesenacher on the Laber in 1364.
issued in 1364 a court charter by which the monastery of Kastel was put in use and possession of the Mittermühle and Görenmühle near Wesenacher on the Laber.
